profile.headline: Software Engineer at SSi
profile.summary: Senior DevOps Engineer with experience working in the insurance industry and currently working in the banking industry. Skilled in Jenkins, Git, Java, SQL, JavaScript, and Customer Service. Experience working with AWS, Frog, Postman, Terraform, Docker, Intellij, Eclipse, Kubernetes, and SOAPUI.  I have Bachelor's degree focused in Computer Science and Minor in Mathematics  from Northern Kentucky University.  Love taking on new and challenging task to use my knowledge I have obtained, and learning everywhere there is an opportunity to do so.
